reranked_evidence.title: Lalu Prasad Yadav
reranked_evidence.snippet: # Lalu Prasad Yadav. | Lalu as Union Minister of Railways "Ministry of Railways (India)"), addressing in New Delhi on 12 September 2004 |. **Lalu Prasad Yadav** (born 11 June 1948) is an Indian politician who served as the chief minister of Bihar from 1991 to 1997 and as the union minister for Railways "Railway Minister (India)") from 2004 to 2009. He is the founding president of the Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD), a prominent political party in Bihar. He entered politics at Patna University as a student leader and, in 1977, was elected as one of the youngest members of the Lok Sabha for the Bharatiya Lok Dal of the Janata Alliance. He became the chief minister of Bihar in 1990. His party came to power in the 2015 Bihar Legislative Assembly election in coalition with Nitish Kumar of JD(U) "Janata Dal (United)"). Lalu was convicted in the Fodder Scam and was serving a term until 17 April 2021, when he was granted bail by the High Court.
